title: Unit 2: Terrible disasters
content:
Joyful Primary School Newsletter — September issue

An unusual rainstorm hit Hong Kong last week. Heavy rain poured down over the city. It also brought challenges to the animal shelter run by Bright House, an animal charity. Our school's Volunteering Club has already spent a day doing voluntary work there, but Bright House still needs more support. Read on to learn more about Bright House and find out how you can help.

Bright House is a charity which helps cats and dogs in Hong Kong. It gives the animals a safe place to live. It takes good care of them too. Since it started five years ago, it has helped over 200 cats and dogs.

During the rainstorm, a flood hit the animal shelter of Bright House. The workers quickly moved the animals to higher places so that they could stay safe. There was a landslip during the rainstorm too. Luckily, it only blocked the road outside the shelter and did not injure any animals.

Although all the animals and workers are safe after the rainstorm, the shelter no longer provides a comfortable home. It is now wet and dirty. The flood also washed away food and medicine for the animals. If the shelter gets help soon, the animals will have a safe home again.

Bright House needs your help. You can help by making donations. The shelter needs food and medicine for the animals. It needs things like clean towels and cleaning supplies too. You can also be a volunteer. On 23 September, Bright House will hold a clean-up event so that everyone can help tidy up its shelter. If there are enough volunteers, the shelter will be able to reopen shortly.

Please sign up for the clean-up event so that Bright House can carry on with its good work. Visit its website for details. With your help, the animals will have a clean and comfortable home again soon.

discussionQuestions: 💬 Side Discussion Question: Have you experienced any natural disasters? How did you feel?
supplementary.learningElementsMarkdown:
### 📌 Inserted Learning & Skill Elements

- **Values Education:** **Support good causes**  
  - How can you help different people in need?
  - How do you feel after helping others?

- **Class Discussion Task:**  
  How can you help others after a natural disaster? Do a presentation in class.

- **Our Culture & National Security Education (National security education: ecological security):**  
  **Chinese hero Da Yu**  
  Da Yu was famous for controlling river floods. He worked hard for 13 years without giving up. In the end, he succeeded. Like Da Yu, we should not give up when we face problems. China has also worked hard to protect the environment by planting trees and reducing waste. Caring for our environment helps reduce damage from natural disasters. What can you do to help reduce waste? Why is it important for everyone to work together to protect the environment?
